description: A script that converts 'gherkin-languages.json' into an I18N Python module for use with behave, including functions for downloading and normalizing language data, and command-line interface for execution.

methods.name: download_file
methods.description: Downloads content from a URL and saves it to a file.

methods.name: data_normalize
methods.description: Normalizes the gherkin languages JSON data into internal format.

methods.name: gherkin_languages_to_python_module
methods.description: Converts gherkin-languages.json into a Python I18N module, writing to file or stdout.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for command-line execution, orchestrates the conversion process.
